input = sys.stdin.readline

n, m = map(int, input().split())
mod = m
dp = [0] * (n + 3)
dp[n] = 1
sdp = [0] * (n + 3)
sdp[n] = 1

for x in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
    dp[x] = (dp[x] + sdp[x + 1]) % mod
    max_z = n // x
    for z in range(2, max_z + 1):
        l = x * z
        r = (x + 1) * z - 1
        if r > n:
            r = n
        dp[x] = (dp[x] + sdp[l] - sdp[r + 1]) % mod
    sdp[x] = (sdp[x + 1] + dp[x]) % mod

print(dp[1] % mod)
